ja223:1.1: Reverence to the reverent, follow the one who follows (you),
ja223:1.2: She should do her duty to the one doing his duty,
ja223:1.3: (But) she need not do good to the one who wishes her harm,
ja223:1.4: No one needs to love those who do not have love (in return).
ja223:2.1: Abandon the one who abandons, not having desire,
ja223:2.2: She need not love the one who is devoid of thought (for her).
ja223:2.3: A bird, knowing that a tree is devoid of fruit,
ja223:2.4: Can look for another (tree) in this great wide world.
